messages:
Mara: Quick pulse	we need a crisp benchmark narrative for the launch post + a tiny webinar. Focus: latency vs unit cost.
Alex: Lead visual should be a scatter: median latency (ms) on x, cost per 1k tokens on y, colored by deployment. Callout: median improvement and p99 note.
Sam: I'll produce CSV with median, p95, p99, cost_per_1k, tokens_per_request, deployment_mode. Also a small violin for p99 variance.
Priya: Headline draft: 'Predictable latency. Lower inference cost.' Subhead: 'Same model quality, clearer economics across hosted, dedicated, and private.'
Noah: Routing rule: if Expected_RPS >= 50 OR Compliance contains SOC2/PCI/HIPAA -> Enterprise, else Growth. Tag leads with Interest: latency/cost/throughput. Use fields Expected_RPS__c, Compliance_Requirements__c.
Jen: Webinar 30m: 10m claims + demo, 10m charts deep dive, 10m Q&A. CTA: 'Run your workload on Redwood get a tailored latency & cost report in 48h.' Form asks Expected RPS, Avg tokens/request, Compliance.
Mara: Agreed. Avoid direct vendor names; include measurement notes (tokens = prompt + response). Sam: CSV upload by EOD.
launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot requested 2026-05-05 15:00 UTC. Confirm within 48h. :calendar:
Mara: Confirmed. Ops will get the runbook.
